units.source_text: （听说世上有人花十年功夫，把圆周率计算到小数点以下几百位……

en.t: I hear there are people in the world who spend ten years calculating pi to several hundred decimal places...

units.source_text: 就是那样也有存在的理由嘛……

en.t: Even something like that has its reason for existing...

units.source_text: 可是，正因为你拒绝那样的存在理由，所以，才特地来到这个地方……）

en.t: But precisely because you rejected that kind of reason for existing, you went out of your way to come to this place...
